metadata.article_title: Time within which hearing under rule 11 should be concluded.

article.title: Time within which hearing under rule 11 should be concluded.
article.content:
11ATime within which hearing under rule 11 should be concluded.

Order 41, Rule 11A
Every appeal shall be hear under rule 11 as expeditiously as possible and endeavour shall be made to conclude such hearing within sixty days from the date on which the memorandum of appeal is filed.]

5 Ins. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 87 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
